output.headline: Provider-focused sponsor with an open platform in the sub-sector: the target is a natural add-on, backed by Midwest deal experience and a $5 billion-plus fund.
output.differentiator: It has an open platform in the sub-sector, giving a clear add-on route, and the Midwest is its largest region at 6 deals. No peer comparison was supplied, so no lead is claimed. [A:angles, T:record]
output.why_them: Add-on to its open platform; pays upper-quartile prices

acquirer_overview.title: A provider-focused sponsor with a fresh fund and a 23-deal record
points: Financial sponsor with 23 deals from 2017 to 2023; 18 closed (78%), 8 of them since 2022. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:recent]
Investment focus is technology and healthcare; it raised over $5 billion in its largest private equity fund to date (2023 headline). [P:1, P:2]
Median deal of $172M sits close to the $200M target; 9 of 23 deals fall in the $100M-$400M band. [T:record, K:size_band]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An add-on to an open platform, backed by a provider record
points: One deal in the target's own sub-sector and 15 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; sub-sector relevance is a modest factor in its likelihood. [T:record, S:sector_rel]
Cross-sell was the motive in 8 of 23 deals, against 21% of all deals in the file, which points to a revenue-synergy buyer. [M:cross_sell]
Its open platform in the sub-sector makes the target an add-on; 16 of 23 of its deals are provider businesses. [A:angles]

precedent_activity.title: Midwest and large-cap precedents show it can price and size this deal
points: Jefferson Ambulatory Care, the target's own sub-sector: $75M management buyout in the Midwest, 2021, at 17.8x EV/EBITDA, closed. [D:MA-2021-0083]
Woodland PACE: $204M management buyout, 2021, at 17.6x, closed. This is the size closest to the target. [D:MA-2021-0025]
Clearwater Mental Health: $398M Midwest recapitalization, 2023, at 16.8x. It was withdrawn. [D:MA-2023-0166]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, and it already pays at that level
points: Comparable deals (70) run from 10.7x at the 25th percentile to 12.8x at the median and 15.3x at the 75th. [V:comps]
The 75th percentile is defensible because the 16.8% margin exceeds the comparable median of 12.9% and tops 87% of comps. [V:comps]
Its median paid is 16.2x. At 5.0x leverage the equity cheque is $128M, and the maximum price is $193M on a same-multiple exit or $216M on a platform exit. [V:comps, V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask is 18.7%, below its 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.reality: The bid works only if it underwrites the add-on exit; the same-multiple exit caps at $193M. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Execution record
risk_flags.concern: Only 18 of 23 deals closed (78%), a slight factor against it. [K:closed_share, S:close_rate_s]
risk_flags.mitigant: Closed deals include the Midwest Jefferson buyout and the $204M Woodland PACE buyout. [D:MA-2021-0083, D:MA-2021-0025]
risk_flags.reality: Clearwater ($398M) and Delta Multispecialty ($38M) were both withdrawn, so process certainty needs testing. [D:MA-2023-0166, D:MA-2022-0024]

risk_flags.title: Thin own-sub-sector record
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 of 23 deals is in the target's own sub-sector. [T:record]
risk_flags.mitigant: 15 more deals are in adjacent provider sub-sectors, and the open platform gives an add-on route. [T:record, A:angles]
risk_flags.reality: Its fit rests on provider breadth and the platform, not on repeated own-sub-sector buying. [T:record]

conviction.rationale: High because it has 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 15 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, and an open platform in the sub-sector gives it an add-on route. [C:conviction, T:record]
